svg.text: UML CLASS SPECIFICATION: DOMAIN ENTITIES & RELATIONAL ARCHITECTURE
Multi-Tenant Relational Schema, Object Multiplicities (1..*), Biometric Vector Types & Service Interfaces
• Multi-Tenant Scoping: All organizational entities (Company, Department, Employee, KnowledgeBase) enforce strict company_id database partitioning.
• Biometric Vector Storage: 128-dimensional facial embedding vector indices leverage pgvector indexing with Euclidean (<->) search operators.
• Offline Resiliency: OfflinePunch mirrors client IndexedDB schema with monotonic synchronization state tracking (synced: 0 | 1) for seamless recovery.
